{{Quote|Trivia: I estimate this room alone cost over thirteen million credits to construct and decorate.|[[HK-51]], regarding the opulence of Toborro's palace|<ref name="Hutt Cartel">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref>.}}
'''Toborro's Palace''' was a palace on [[Makeb]] that belonged to the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel's]] [[Supreme Mogul]], Toborro the Hutt, during the [[Conquest of Makeb]]. The renowned [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Juvard Illip Oggurobb]] had built and designed the palace<ref name="SIS" /> for the Grand Mogul and had even built a secret entrance into the palace without Toborro's knowledge. This entrance later gave the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] the upper-hand in the invasion and allowed a hero to get into Toborro's throne room and defeat him<ref name="Hutt Cartel" />
